Name: Vanilla Refreshed - Bachelorettes
Author: TariVendice
Description:
Vanilla Refreshed Bachelorettes (and Bachelors) is my first mod for Stardew Valley. It retouches the dateable vanilla characters while still keeping what makes them the characters we love.

[b]Abigail[/b] - Gave Abby a more punk look. (You may notice that she has the same buttons as Vanilla Refreshed Sam and Sebastian.) She also has a configurable option for green highlights.
[b]Emily[/b] - The character that inspired this entire mod! I cleaned up her hair, gave her jewelry and gave her a lacey cardigan worthy of a fashion designer.
[b]Haley[/b] - I straightened and lightened Haley's hair to really embody that mean-girl-with-a-heart-of-gold energy. She also has a pink outfit. Perfect for Wednesdays!
[b]Leah[/b] - Her hair gets a bit of a more practical retouch for a forager and her clothes got an earthy recolor.
[b]Maru[/b] - retouched with an overall darker, warmer color palette and gave her curlier/wavier hair.
[b]Penny[/b] - Penny lets her hair down! I gave her a bit of color while still keeping a girl-next-door vibe.

All characters have also been given slight (and not-so-slight) tweaks to their faces/necks to give them a cleaner look. Beach portraits are also included.

[b]Installation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.
[*]Download the main file and unzip it.
[*]Move the folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder.
[*]That's it!
[/list]

[b]Possible Future Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]matching sprites
[*]winter sprites (post 1.6 release)
[/list]
